# Las Vegas Pole Rentals (LVPR)

> Las Vegas Pole Rentals is the #1 pole rental service in Las Vegas. We deliver portable Lupit pole stages — set up by a technician, picked up the next day — to hotels, event venues, and private homes across Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, and Paradise. Rates start at $250 for 24 hours. Same-day service available. Owned by Pole Fitness Studio, founded by Fawnia Mondey in the pole industry since 1994.

## Key facts

- **Service:** portable stripper pole / pole dance stage rental
- **Location:** Las Vegas, Nevada (mobile delivery — no storefront)
- **Service area:** Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, Paradise, Spring Valley
- **Phone:** 702-205-1440 (call or text — same number)
- **Email:** rent@lasvegaspolerentals.com
- **Pricing:** $250 for 24-hour rental · $200 per additional day
- **Equipment:** Lupit Pole stages with Quick Lock™ (spin or static, change modes in under a second, no tools)
- **Pole heights:** 8'4" or 9'8" — bring whichever matches your ceiling
- **Stage:** 5'3" diameter, 6 anti-slip legs, needs ~5'10" clear space
- **Weight limit:** 180 lbs standard, more with long-leg option
- **Setup:** 5–10 minutes by our technician
- **Same-day rentals:** yes
- **Booking:** call or text 702-205-1440, or use the contact form
- **Founded:** Fawnia Mondey, in pole industry since 1994; serving Las Vegas since 2005
- **Parent company:** [Pole Fitness Studio](https://www.polefitnessstudio.com)

## Common questions

- **Can you deliver to a hotel room?** Yes — we'll get past hotel security and leave the room in the same condition we found it.
- **What kind of poles do you rent?** Lupit Pole stages. Stainless steel or chrome (both silver, visually identical). We replaced our X-pole and Platinum Stages inventory with Lupit.
- **What's the weight limit?** 180 lbs (80 kg) standard. Long-leg option for heavier performers adds stability.
- **Do your poles spin?** Yes — automotive/aerospace-engineered Lupit Quick Lock™. Spin to static in under a second, no tools.
- **Same-day rentals?** Yes — first come, first served. Advance booking recommended.
- **When is payment due?** Day of setup, before installation. $200 per additional day to extend.
- **How many years in business?** Owner Fawnia Mondey has been in pole since 1994, serving Las Vegas since 2005.

## Reasonable use cases for LVPR

- Hotel-room pole for an anniversary, birthday, bachelorette, or bachelor party
- Stage pole for a corporate trade-show booth or product launch
- Production rental for photo or video shoots in Las Vegas
- Private event entertainment at a Vegas residence
- Pop-up rental for a touring performer with a Vegas date

## What LVPR is not

- Not a pole dance studio — that's the parent company, [Pole Fitness Studio](https://www.polefitnessstudio.com)
- Not a permanent installation service — rentals only
- Not available outside the Las Vegas Valley (call for exceptions)
